title: Telemetry v2
description: Canonical telemetry payload emitted by ESP32 bridge and consumed by iot-gateway, Digital Twin, and dashboard. Resolves incompatibility between ESP32 raw format (received_at_ms/values/pairs) and v1 schema (timestamp/state/sensors).

schema_version.description: Schema version identifier. Must be '2.0' for v2 canonical format.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) when the telemetry was captured at the gateway boundary. Converted from ESP32 received_at_ms + gateway wall-clock offset.

source_format.description: Indicates the original telemetry format from the bridge. 'amlp-raw' = v1 legacy (values/pairs); 'amlp-structured' = future structured format.

uptime_ms.description: ESP32 monotonic timestamp (milliseconds since boot) at telemetry capture. Identical to received_at_ms from raw payload.

raw.description: Original ESP32 telemetry payload (v1 bridge output). Present when source_format is 'amlp-raw'.

values.description: Raw string values from AMLP TEL frame.

pairs.description: Key-value pairs from AMLP TEL frame.

truncated.description: True if any telemetry fields were dropped due to buffer overflow.

overflow_dropped_values.description: Number of raw values dropped due to overflow.

overflow_dropped_pairs.description: Number of key-value pairs dropped due to overflow.

structured.description: Normalized sensor and state data. Populated by gateway translator from raw payload.

temperature_centi_c.description: Temperature in hundredths of degrees Celsius (divide by 100).

humidity_centi_percent.description: Relative humidity in hundredths of a percent (divide by 100).

custom.description: Additional sensor key-value pairs not mapped to standard fields.

gateway_id.description: Identifier of the gateway that processed this telemetry.

translated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the gateway performed translation.
